extracted.name: Pumpkin Protein Shake
ingredient_lines: 1 1/2 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice (, or more, to taste)
1 cup unsweetened or vanilla almond milk
instruction_lines: Combine: Add the frozen banana, pumpkin butter, protein powder, oats, pumpkin pie spice, and nutmeg to a blender.
Add almond milk and top with the ice cubes.
Blend on high for 30 to 60 seconds, scraping down the sides as needed, until smooth and creamy. Pour into a glass and serve immediately.
categories: How to make a pumpkin protein shake
